svg.title: Diagram 5. Workspace hop (MVP-D) and cross-workspace split (v1)
svg.desc: The router (the main agent first step, classifier fallback) runs on the home profile and returns a hop command (switch_workspace_once, switch_workspace_session, reset_workspace) or a hint. ProfileService resolves databricks-cli profiles: 1 match hops, 2 or more show Which workspace, 0 offers Connect a workspace. The hop shows the badge and the banner Asking in B. Context from A is not shared. TokenBroker gets token B; McpTransport opens a new MCP session for B, and a 404 shows Genie One is not available in the host. New questions start new conversations in B; old ones stay pinned. STT, cleanup, router, writer, embeddings and memory stay on the home profile, and the UI says so. Memory stores a pointer only for B answers. A once hop expires after one question, a session hop at the session end, and reset_workspace returns home at once. The v1 split asks up to 3 parts in parallel and merges with labels.

Numbered steps (F5; step 10 is F6, v1)
1 The router runs on the home profile; the UI discloses it (W-21).
2 ProfileService matches aliases, names, hosts in order: 1 match hops, 2+ ask, 0 offers setup (W-11c, W-07).
3 The hop applies for one question or one session. The badge and the banner change (W-20).
4 TokenBroker gets token B from the CLI (W-06). Token A stays in its own cache.
5 McpTransport opens a new MCP session for B; a 404 shows "Genie One isn't available in <host>" (G-05b).
6 genie_ask goes to B with ?o=<wsid B> and Bearer B only. New conversation in B (W-12, G-27).
7 Old conversations stay pinned and parked for 30 min; a follow-up goes to the old workspace (G-26c/d, G-27).
8 Memory stays local on the home profile: pointer only for B answers (MEM-25a..c). v1 sync follows the same rule.
9 The hop expires after one question, at session end, or on reset_workspace.
10 v1 split (W-13, SC-6, F6): up to 3 parts in parallel, each with its own bucket; merge with labels.
